Counterattack: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put N damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

Counterattacking Crest: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place N damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
Counterturn: If there are N or fewer cards in your deck, this attack does N more damage.
Covert Flight: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.
Crackling Charge: Flip N coins. Attach a number of Basic Lightning Energy cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
Craftsmanship: This Pokémon gets +N HP for each Fighting Energy attached to it.
Crazy Blast: If this Pokémon used Pervasive Gas during your last turn, this attack does N more damage.
Crescendo Wave: This attack does N damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. Before doing damage, you may attach any number of Basic Water Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.
Crescent Purge: You may turn N of your face-down Prize cards face up. If you do, this attack does N more damage. (That Prize card remains face up for the rest of the game.)
Critical Slash: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
Cross Breaker: Discard up to N Metal Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does N damage for each card you discarded in this way.
Crushing Press: You may discard a Stadium in play. If you do, this attack does N more damage.
Crushing Pulse: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard all Item cards and Pokémon Tool cards you find there.
Crystal Fall: If you have at least N Water Energy in play, this attack does N more damage.

Curly Wall: As long as you have at least N other Bouffalant in play, all of your Basic Colorless Pokémon take N less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Curly Wall doesn't stack.
Cursed Drop: Put N damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
Cursed Edge: Discard all Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon.
Cursed Roots: During your opponent's next turn, Energy can't be attached from your opponent's hand to the Defending Pokémon.
Cursed Slug: If your opponent has N or fewer cards in their hand, this attack does N more damage.
Cursed Words: Your opponent chooses N cards from their hand and shuffles those cards into their deck.
Cutting Riposte: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack can be used for Darkness.
Cyber Drive: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Cyber Drive.
Damage Collection: You may move any number of damage counters from your opponent's Benched Pokémon to their Active Pokémon.

Dark Awakening: Choose up to N of your Darkness Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
Dark Frost: If this Pokémon has any Team Rocket's Energy attached, this attack does N more damage.
Dark Strike: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dark Strike.
Darkest Impulse: Whenever your opponent plays a Pokémon from their hand to evolve N of their Pokémon, put N damage counters on that Pokémon. The effect of Darkest Impulse doesn't stack.
Darkfall: If you have at least N Darkness Energy in play, this attack does N more damage.
Dastardly Jab: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is N.
Daunting Gaze: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Item cards from their hand.
Daydream: During your opponent's next turn, if they attach an Energy card from their hand to the Defending Pokémon, their turn ends.
Debut Performance: If you go first, this Pokémon can use attacks during your first turn.
Defiant Horn: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve N of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch in N of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
Deleting Slash: If your opponent has N or more Benched Pokémon, this attack does N more damage.
Destined Fight: Both Active Pokémon are Knocked Out.
Destructive Headbutting: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Destructo-Press: Reveal the top N cards of your deck. This attack does N damage for each Future card you find there. Then, discard those Future cards and shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
Devolution Ray: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.
Devolve N of your evolved Psychic Pokémon by putting any number of Evolution cards on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can't evolve this turn.)
Devouring Mouth: If this Pokémon has more Energy attached than your opponent's Active Pokémon, this attack does N more damage.
Diffuse Reflection: This attack does N damage for each Special Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.
Dig Dig Dig: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to N Basic Fighting Energy cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.
Dig It Up: Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.
Dirty Headbutt: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dirty Headbutt.
Disaster Shock: You may discard N Lightning Energy from this Pokémon and make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.
Discard a Pokémon Tool and a Special Energy from N of your opponent's Pokémon.
Discard a Special Energy from N of your opponent's Pokémon.
Discard all Pokémon Tools and Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon, and discard a Stadium in play.
Discard up to N Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your hand, and draw N cards for each card you discarded in this way. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V_atk, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
Discard your hand and search your deck for a Pokémon, a Supporter card, and a Basic Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
Discharge: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does N damage for each card you discarded in this way.
Disconnect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
